verdicts.reason: A is chaos: the badge pills are scattered into all four corners, the logo collides with a stray red fragment, the headline is tiny and no bigger than the body copy, RSVP is shrunk to a badge-sized pill off to the right, and 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' has dropped to the bottom, so the reading order is broken. B at least makes 'Sunset Sessions' the dominant element, but RSVP is just one more pill in the badge row with no CTA weight, the logo sits jammed in the top-left corner on the clipped circle, the time/venue and URL text are stranded at the far left and right edges, a stray red placeholder sits after TASTINGS, and the small product graphic floats with no clear purpose.
